purpose: The AppImage's bundled components that are not Qt modules (Qt's own SPDX documents map those) or Ubuntu packages (dpkg maps those). tools/releases/appimage_notices.py assigns every AppDir file to exactly one component from these patterns, copies each component's licence texts and writes the image's runtime-notices.txt and bundled-components.json (#417). Versions and source locations come from the build: the put.gd build identity, packaging/appimage/tools.lock.json, the installed dependency-lock.json and the Proton runtime manifest. 'files' and 'noticeFiles' are AppDir paths (fnmatch patterns); 'licenseFiles' are paths in the component's pinned licence source (build/dependencies/appimage/ID); a 'licenseTexts' value is an AppDir path (usr/...) or a path in that licence source, and SPDX ids without one use LICENSES/ID.txt. A 'versionFile' must exist in the Qt install, so a Qt bump that changes the version fails until the lock follows.

components.name: put.gd

embedded.name: IBM Plex Sans Regular, Medium and SemiBold

components.note: The Wayland protocol files beside the notices keep the copyright and permission text of the protocols whose generated client bindings are compiled into put.gd.

components.name: AWS SDK for C++ (with aws-crt-cpp, the aws-c libraries and s2n-tls)
components.note: The aws-*-NOTICE files are the SDK's and CRT's Apache-2.0 NOTICE files. cJSON, TinyXML-2, libcbor and xxHash are compiled into the SDK and CRT libraries.

components.name: put.gd Proton Drive helper (Proton Drive SDK, Bun runtime, OpenPGP and crypto libraries)
components.note: THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt and redistribution/ list every package compiled into the helper, with its licence.

components.name: LayerShellQt
components.license: (LGPL-2.1-only OR LGPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-LGPL) AND MIT
components.note: The library and plugin sources are LGPL-2.1-only OR LGPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-LGPL; the compiled wlr-layer-shell protocol is MIT.

components.name: FFmpeg
components.note: Configured with --enable-gpl and the components in packaging/appimage/media.json; LICENSE.md explains the GPL build.

components.name: ICU (International Components for Unicode), shipped with Qt
components.license: Unicode-DFS-2016 AND ICU AND BSD-3-Clause AND NAIST-2003
components.note: The official Qt binaries' own ICU build; icu4c/LICENSE holds the Unicode licence and the third-party terms of the code and data in the libraries.

components.name: AppImage type2-runtime
components.note: The runtime is the start of the AppImage file itself, not a file in the AppDir. appimage-runtime-LICENSE names the libraries linked into it statically.

components.name: mimalloc (statically linked into the AppImage runtime)
components.note: The exact runtime mi_version returns 217, identifying mimalloc 2.1.7. Its source is included in the complete source asset and its original MIT notice is retained here.
